mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory_log (product_id, change_type, change_quantity, before_stock, after_stock, related_order_no, operator_id, remark) VALUES (#{productId}, #{changeType}, #{changeQuantity}, #{beforeStock}, #{afterStock}, #{relatedOrderNo}, #{operatorId}, #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT il.*, p.name AS product_name, u.real_name AS operator_name FROM inventory_log il LEFT JOIN product p ON il.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON il.operator_id = u.id WHERE il.product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY il.create_time DESC
